title: NodeRuntimes
description: Install and login state of every runtime CLI the daemon knows (unreliable). Sent after welcome (reason hello), then only when something changed (periodic check or a watched credential file changed), and always as the answer to node.runtimes_refresh. Always carries the full set of known runtimes, so the console replaces its stored state. Sent only when hello.features contains runtime_status. Never carries credentials: only file metadata and non-secret fields are read.

runtimes.description: Keyed by runtime id (claude, codex, and any runtime added later; same ids as common.json Runtime). Receivers ignore ids they do not know.

reason.description: hello: first report after welcome; periodic: the timed check found a change; fs_event: a watched CLI or credential file changed; refresh: answer to node.runtimes_refresh (sent even without changes).

in_reply_to.description: Envelope id of the node.runtimes_refresh this answers; only with reason refresh.

installed.description: The CLI (or SDK) was found and runs.

version.description: CLI version as reported by the CLI, when known.

path.description: Absolute path of the executable that was found.

auth.description: How the runtime is logged in: subscription (provider account login, e.g. Claude subscription), chatgpt (Codex ChatGPT login), api_key, none (not logged in), unknown (could not tell, e.g. not installed or the check failed).

auth_expires_at.description: When the login expires, only when it can be read from file metadata or non-secret fields.

expired.description: The login is known to be expired (the console treats it like auth none for scheduling).

checked_at.description: When the daemon ran this check.

error.description: Why the check failed or the CLI did not run; never contains credential content.
